errors.what: Loop 1 transmission angle (crank O2-A vs coupler1 A-B) leaves the 30-150 degree window: crank and coupler1 are nearly collinear (about 170 degrees) near crank 90 and nearly folded back (about 30 degrees or less) near crank 330, i.e. close to a dead-centre. The link lengths do not satisfy the spec's transmission-angle requirement.
